components.name: Solar Cells (Monocrystalline Silicon)
components.reasoning: These are the core photovoltaic elements converting sunlight to electricity and are always provided as a distinct module or assembled string within the panel.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: This is the transparent front layer providing physical protection and durability, typically procured separately and laminated onto the module.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: The structural frame supports the panel, provides mounting interfaces, and is almost universally a separate procured component.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: Houses electrical connections and bypass diodes, enabling safe and efficient module interconnection; commonly a separately assembled unit mounted on the back.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA Sheets)
components.reasoning: Encapsulant sheets secure and protect solar cells within the module, procured separately as polymer films typically used in lamination.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: The rear protective layer provides moisture and electrical insulation, is a distinct laminate or polymer sheet procured separately, though some premium modules use glass-glass construction.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Monocrystalline silicon PV modules dominate over 80% of the global solar panel market in 2024 due to their high efficiency (around 20-22%) and cost-effective manufacturing, making them the industry standard for residential, commercial, and utility-scale applications.

components.name: Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells
components.reasoning: These are the core functional elements converting sunlight to electricity, universally present and procured as part of cell strings or wafers before module assembly.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: High-strength tempered glass protects the solar cells from environmental damage and is a separate, standardized component fitted to the front of nearly all PV modules.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: Aluminum framing provides mechanical support, mounting points and structural integrity to the panel; it is a distinct manufactured assembly standard across the industry.

components.name: Encapsulation Layers (EVA or POE)
components.reasoning: Encapsulant films are manufactured polymer sheets layered to protect cells electrically and mechanically; procured as separate lamination materials.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: The backsheet is a protective polymer layer that provides moisture resistance and electrical insulation, supplied as a discrete sheet component.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: The junction box houses electrical connections and bypass diodes, is mounted on the rear of the panel, and is a separately procured electrical assembly.

components.name: Bypass Diode Assembly (within Junction Box)
components.reasoning: Though usually integrated inside the junction box, bypass diodes are critical distinct components protecting cell strings from shading loss and are specifically procured electronic parts.

components.name: Mounting Brackets/Clips
components.reasoning: Mounting hardware is commonly procured separately to secure panels to racking systems, varying by installation but standard in construction.

components.name: Interconnect Ribbon Wire (pre-tabbed strings)
components.reasoning: These are conductive ribbon assemblies connecting cells; they are semi-standardized components often purchased pre-tabbed but not as raw wire.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Monocrystalline silicon photovoltaic (PV) module primarily designed for rooftop or ground-mount solar energy generation with standard framed assembly.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Monocrystalline silicon PV modules dominate global solar panel production (>85%) due to their high efficiency and cost-effectiveness, and their construction includes well-defined structural components essential for durability and installation.
